# Reference values

`reference.json` is generated by `tests/export_reference.py` of the Python
repository (`Yuu-Miino/mappy`) and copied here verbatim. It holds, for each
test system (Izhikevich, Hénon, forced Duffing, relay oscillator) and
parameter point, the image `y`, `jac`, `hes`, `jac_p`, `hes_p`, the mode
history and the located bifurcation points. Do not edit by hand; regenerate
on the Python side and copy.
